notes.title: Soapy Suds & Squeaky Clean Plates: Dishwashing is Here!
notes.content:
[p]🍽️ [b]New Mini-Game: Dishwashing Mayhem![/b]
Doing the dishes just got chaotic—in the coziest way possible. Our latest [i]Life Dash[/i] update brings you a fast-paced, [b]conveyor belt dishwashing mini-game[/b] that turns a simple chore into a delightful daily challenge.[/p][p][/p][p]🧼 [b]How It Works:[/b]
Plates, pans, and cups move along a busy [b]conveyor belt[/b], and it’s your job to [b]tap each one to clean it[/b] before it reaches the end. [b]Clean, sort, and place each dish back where it belongs[/b]—or risk seeing it crash to the floor in a soapy disaster.[/p][p][/p][p]✨ [b]One-Tap, Full Clean:[/b]
No scrubbing, no rinsing—just [b]satisfying single taps[/b] that make each dish sparkle. But don’t get too comfortable… the belt doesn’t slow down.[/p][p][/p][p]🏃‍♀️ [b]A Cozy Rush:[/b]
It’s the perfect mix of cozy and hectic, built to bring life to one of the game’s most common activities. Whether you’re working a kitchen job or just tidying up at home, dishwashing now feels alive.[/p][p][/p][p]🧽 [b]Another Fan-Favorite Feature—Delivered![/b]
This update continues our rollout of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3589130/view/514090522374045731"]Top 5 Most Requested Features[/url]. Keep your eyes peeled—[b]two more community favorites are coming up next.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]—
[i]So tap fast, sort smart, and try not to let the dishes pile up. The kitchen’s calling in Life Dash![/i][/p]

notes.title: Voices in the Crowd: NPCs Come to Life in Life Dash!
notes.content:
[p]🎙️ [b]The Streets Just Got Louder—In the Best Way[/b]
Ever wondered what the burger guy [i]really[/i] sounds like? Or what that stylish fashion store manager might say when you walk in with messy shoes? We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Life Dash now features unique custom voiceovers for all our NPCs![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to the magic of [b]Eleven Labs[/b], every character—[b]from interactive NPCs like shopkeepers and university teachers, to background street wanderers—now speaks[/b]. These voices aren’t just chatter; they [b]bring flavor, warmth, and humor[/b] to every corner of your Life Dash journey.[/p][p][/p][p]💬 [b]Why This Matters[/b]
In cozy games, personality is everything. We’ve worked hard to give each NPC a distinct sound that [b]matches their story, vibe, and role[/b]—whether it's a grumpy granny in the office or a cheerful street vendor cheering you on. Now, every interaction feels just a little more real (and a lot more fun).[/p][p][/p][p]📝 [b]A Most Requested Feature... Delivered![/b]
If you caught our recent update about the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3589130/view/514090522374045731"]Top 5 Most Requested Features[/url], you’ll remember [b]NPC voices landed high on the list[/b]. We heard you loud and clear—and now, so can you.[/p][p][/p][p]🎉 And yes… [b]two more highly requested features are coming right up.[/b] Stay tuned 😉[/p][p][/p][p]—[/p][p]
[i]Whether you're racing to your next job or just soaking in the cozy streets of Life Dash, let the voices around you guide, distract, and delight. See you in the game![/i][/p]

notes.title: You Asked, We Listened: Top 5 Most Requested Features Coming Soon! 🎮
notes.content: [h3]🌟 [b]Dear Dashers,[/b][/h3][p]Your passion and feedback have been incredible! We're thrilled to reveal the [b]TOP 5 MOST REQUESTED FEATURES[/b] that are currently in development.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🐾 #5 - Loyal Pet Companions[/b][/h3][p][i]"Can we have pets that follow us everywhere?"[/i][/p][p]Your wish is our command! Soon you'll be able to adopt adorable companions that'll stick by your side through every cozy adventure. From playful puppies to curious cats, these furry friends will add even more warmth to your daily routines.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🎙️ #4 - Fully Voiced NPCs[/b][/h3][p][i]"Please add character voices!"[/i][/p][p]Say goodbye to silent conversations! We're bringing every NPC to life. Each character will have their own unique personality that you'll hear in every interaction, making your cozy world feel more alive than ever.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]✨ #3 - New Locations & Career Paths[/b][/h3][p][i]"More jobs and places to explore!"[/i][/p][p]Ready for fresh adventures? We're expanding your world with exciting new locations and career opportunities. Ever dreamed of being a content creator? You'll soon be able to work as a streamer for an online media company, complete with all the cozy vibes you love![/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]💕 #2 - Deep NPC Relationships[/b][/h3][p][i]"We want meaningful connections!"[/i][/p][p]Your social life is about to get a major upgrade! Build lasting friendships, and create meaningful bonds with the characters you meet. The choice is yours in crafting your perfect social circle.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🎮 #1 - Interactive Job Mini-Games[/b][/h3][p][i]"Make work more engaging!"[/i][/p][p]This is the big one! Every career path will feature unique, engaging mini-games that make work feel like play. Whether you're washing dishes, serving customers, selling clothes, or managing a store, you'll have fun, skill-based activities that keep every workday exciting and rewarding.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🚀 What's Next?[/b][/h3][p]These features represent months of development inspired directly by YOUR feedback. We're working hard to bring each one to life.[/p][p][b]Want to stay updated?[/b] Follow our Steam page and join our community discussions (have you checked our official Discord?)! Your continued feedback helps shape the future of our cozy world.[/p][p][b]Expected Timeline:[/b] More details on release dates coming in our next development update![/p][hr][/hr][p][i]Thank you for being the most wonderful, supportive community a developer could ask for. Your enthusiasm drives everything we do! 💙[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h3]📱 [b]Stay Connected:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Follow for development updates[/p][/*][*][p]Join community discussions[/p][/*][*][p]Share your thoughts in the comments below![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New Demo Update! Leaderboards, Controller Support & More!
notes.content:
[p]We’ve just rolled out an exciting update to the [b]Life Dash[/b] demo — and it’s packed with features designed to improve your experience![/p][p]Here's what's new:
✅ [b]Global Leaderboard[/b] – Race through life and see how your score stacks up against the world!
🎮 [b]Full Controller Support[/b] – Play comfortably from your couch with full gamepad support.
⌨️ [b]Keyboard Navigation[/b] – Menus are now easily navigable without a mouse.
✨ [b]Improved UI[/b] – Cleaner, smoother, and easier to use.
🐛 [b]Bug Fixes[/b] – We squashed several bugs to make your journey even more wholesome.[/p][p]We’d love your feedback as we continue developing Life Dash. Try the updated demo now and let us know what you think!

Follow us on TikTok to see it all in action: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@lifedashgame"]https://www.tiktok.com/@lifedashgame[/url][/p]
